draft.notes: This branch of the Ice Archer T2 should be more of a generalist - still uses a bow, but doesn't need to snipe everything from several spaces away

notes:
Extremely tall, slow, adapted to the cold - these are ancient ice beings. They stand over 7' tall, are very  thin and strong. High defenses, near-zero agility. Have access to extra powerful ranged attacks that can't be used if they move on the same turn.
The  longbowan track focuses on extreme range - 4-5 spaces, the longest ranged attacks outside the sniper class. Accuracy drops off at this range, but these guys hit like a truck, and from very far away.

The  lower track is more of a generalist, and it has access to the colossus class at T3 - which focuses more on high attack and defense, while forgoing its ranged options - however, it keeps the ranged moves it learned at lower classes.
